**Entropy is simply nature’s tendency to get messy.**

Here is the secret: There is only *one* way to arrange the bricks to make that perfect castle. But there are *billions* of ways to arrange the bricks in a messy pile. Because there are so many more ways to be messy than to be tidy, the universe naturally moves toward the mess.

That "mess" is Entropy. If you want to keep your room clean (low entropy), you have to eat a good breakfast and use your energy to pick things up. If you stop using energy, your room will naturally get messy again on its own. The universe loves to spread things out and mix them up!
